name: ipapi
tagline: IP geolocation API for location, ASN, currency, and security data
description: ipapi.co is a geolocation API that maps IP addresses to location and network metadata including city, region, country, timezone, currency, ASN, and optional security fields. Developers call a simple HTTPS JSON endpoint with an optional API key for higher rate limits. Free tier available for light use; paid plans for production volume.

auth.details: Optional API key via path (?key=) or query; free unauthenticated tier available with lower limits. Paid plans require key from self-serve signup.

use_cases: geolocate a client IP for localization
enrich logs with country/city from IP
